page.layout: One blank page of parchment-coloured leaf; no printed text. Only faint, smudged marks (show-through and stains) and remnants of old mounting or binding tabs at the right edge.
page.notes: No printed text, headings, marginal notes, page numbers, running heads, catchwords or signatures are legible on this scan. The dark diagonal and curved smudges, the brownish spots and the faint strokes are stains, offsets and show-through from the facing page or from handling, not printed matter and therefore not transcribed. The page is treated as empty.
